definitions.gloss: made of iron; made of steel; iron-made
definitions.explanation: Describes something manufactured from iron or steel. Used as a modifier with の to describe objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鉄製|てっせい}だ。
examples.english: This gate is made of iron.

examples.japanese: {鉄製|てっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝|つた}わり→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Iron frying pans conduct heat well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{鉄製|てっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{錆|さ}びて→錆びる：07412_sabiru⟧⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{架|か}け{替|か}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}→検討：02710_kentou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The old iron bridge has rusted and deteriorated, so replacement is being considered.

notes:
USAGE: {鉄製|てっせい} follows the productive pattern of material + ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made of). It is used as a noun or as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鉄製|てっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (iron pot)
- {鉄製|てっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧ (iron frying pan)
- {鉄製|てっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ (iron gate)
- {鉄製|てっせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柵|さく}→柵：13103_saku⟧ (iron fence)

RELATED PATTERNS: The ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ suffix is extremely productive. Other common examples include ⟦{木製|もくせい}→木製：13083_mokusei_b⟧ (wooden), ⟦{金属製|きんぞくせい}→金属製：28457_kinzokusei⟧ (metal), {銅製|どうせい} (copper), ⟦{革製|かわせい}→革製：26255_kawasei⟧ (leather), and ⟦{手製|てせい}→手製：12891_tesei⟧ (handmade).
